name: Recital 25
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Erasmus+ programme for the period 2028-2034, and repealing Regulations (EU) 2021/817 and (EU) 2021/888
part_text: (25) It is important to stimulate and widen access to learning, teaching and research on EU, values and citizenship and provide skills essential to foster people’s resilience and empower individuals to actively promote Union values. Fostering a European sense of belonging and commitment is particularly important given the challenges faced today by the Union. The Programme should continue to contribute to learning on European integration matters, including the Union’s future challenges and opportunities, to promote debate on those matters and the development of excellence in European integration studies, also through Jean Monnet actions.
